purpose: Localize the Repair38 PCHIP-or-other floor by freezing the Repair37 Nt128 H4 source nodes, Repair37 projected p0, Repair13 reduced background, H4 operator, shift metric and science target, then varying only the off-node source-at-stage interpolation rule at a fixed internal Radau substep factor of 4.

frozen_inputs.source_nodes: Repair37 frozen primary total_main and total_constraint arrays on Nt128
frozen_inputs.active_mask: Repair37 frozen primary shift-scale mask with the Repair37 near-null threshold

methods.definition: Repair07 PchipInterpolator separately on real and imaginary parts, extrapolate=False
scipy CubicSpline with not-a-knot boundary condition, separately on real and imaginary parts, extrapolate=False
scipy Akima1DInterpolator, separately on real and imaginary parts, extrapolate=False

diagnostic_reference_scale.definition: frozen Repair38 PCHIP factor2-to-factor4 change on the same active shift-metric field
diagnostic_reference_scale.purpose: Use the already observed propagation discretization change as the uncertainty scale instead of an arbitrary absolute interpolation threshold.

diagnostic_routes.STAGE_SOURCE_REPRESENTATION_DEPENDENCE_C: All implementation gates pass and at least one independent interpolant has active shift-metric field L2 difference from PCHIP factor4 at least 4 times the frozen PCHIP factor2-to-factor4 active-field L2 difference. This localizes the remaining floor to off-node source-at-stage representation dependence but does not identify a preferred interpolant or certify Z21.
diagnostic_routes.STAGE_SOURCE_REPRESENTATION_INVARIANT_OT: All implementation gates pass and both independent interpolants have active shift-metric field L2 difference from PCHIP factor4 no larger than the frozen PCHIP factor2-to-factor4 active-field L2 difference. This disfavors source interpolation as the dominant floor and routes to reconstruction/constraint consistency.
diagnostic_routes.MIXED_STAGE_REPRESENTATION_SENSITIVITY: All implementation gates pass but the alternatives fall between the two preregistered localization regimes. Freeze and localize method-specific source/constraint consistency before any science reclosure.
diagnostic_routes.IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: Frozen input binding, PCHIP baseline reproduction, nodal interpolation exactness or finiteness fails. Repair39 may be repaired without changing this preregistered diagnostic contract.
